cases.input: mode:agent is not used; execute docs/tasks/example-tasks.md
cases.expected: Validate under an explicit artifact root, pin validation/digest/source hash, replay source-plan readiness, pass semantic-fit, then create tracker tasks from Task Pack Contract waves.

cases.input: Task-pack source_plan_hash no longer matches the source plan.
cases.expected: Stop before task creation with stale_hash and a copy-ready spec-write-tasks regeneration handoff.
forbidden: fall back to legacy plan parsing

cases.input: Body hash still matches, but source plan frontmatter changed to requirements-only or execution: knowledge-work.
cases.expected: Replay plan intake, return source-plan-intake-drift, and suppress code execution.
forbidden: trust body hash as readiness proof

cases.input: A required Task Card completes focused verification and task-scoped review returns one P1 finding.
cases.expected: Block dependent waves, apply eligible caller-owned fix, rerun affected verification and one bounded follow-up review; stop if round two still blocks.

cases.input: Task delta cannot be attributed and task_diff_isolation is degraded.
cases.expected: Return a required-review blocker with required_gate_eligible false.

cases.input: The task-pack byte digest changes after the first task.
cases.expected: Stop before the next task and rerun full validation plus semantic-fit.

cases.input: The active Task Card stop_if condition is observed.
cases.expected: Stop the task and dependent wave and return to plan/task regeneration.

cases.input: Execute a direct implementation-ready plan with moderate complexity.
cases.expected: Use the existing direct-plan section map; task-pack compilation remains an optional advisory only.
forbidden: load task-pack intake for a trivial bare prompt

cases.input: The requested behavior is already fully provided by a current source-owned helper and its public contract.
cases.expected: Choose reuse, verify the existing contract satisfies the active scope, and do not add a wrapper or parallel implementation.

cases.input: A current owner already owns the boundary and needs one focused behavior supported by its existing extension point.
cases.expected: Choose extend at the canonical owner, preserve its source-of-truth, and verify downstream consumers.

cases.input: Two authoritative capabilities must be sequenced and their partial failures exposed to one caller.
cases.expected: Choose compose/thin-glue; bound translation, sequencing, failure/degradation routing, and evidence aggregation while leaving domain truth and durable state with participants.

cases.input: Existing owners and composition seams would mix responsibilities and the implementation-ready plan explicitly authorizes a new source-owned contract.
cases.expected: Choose new with the rejected owner/composition evidence, clear source-of-truth, consumers, failure behavior, and verification.

cases.input: A wrapper has no current consumer and adds no translation, sequencing, safety, or evidence boundary.
cases.expected: Do not create it; keep the current path or record a deferred idea without widening scope.

cases.input: A nearby helper looks reusable but belongs to a different domain and would need copied policy to fit.
cases.expected: Reject forced reuse, locate the correct owner or return to planning if a new boundary is required.

cases.input: Change one docs sentence without behavior, contract, source-owner, or durable-surface impact.
cases.expected: Use the narrow docs/diff check, stay quiet, and do not emit an architecture matrix or material-deviation note.

cases.input: Update a schema-backed documentation table with no runtime behavior change.
cases.expected: Use schema/render/link or generated-catalog diff checks as the feedback loop and state the non-runtime claim ceiling.

cases.input: Execute a plan explicitly marked execution: knowledge-work.
cases.expected: Load only the non-code production route, read named sources, and produce the deliverable without branch/test/shipping references.

cases.input: One implementation unit is complete but dependent units remain.
cases.expected: Continue the execution loop and focused verification; do not load shipping or claim lifecycle completion yet.

cases.input: Review returned one residual finding, but no residual-gate decision selected tracker filing.
cases.expected: Keep the finding in the residual gate; do not load tracker-defer or perform external actions.

cases.input: A large plan mentions parallelism, but no callable/authorized goal or workflow engine is available.
cases.expected: Use inline or separately authorized workers and record the capability/authorization limitation.
